title: Basketball Team Names: 54 Ideas and a Generator
verdict: Here are basketball team names for rec leagues, youth teams, school intramurals and adult runs, plus a generator that builds new ones from hoops words.
The lists are grouped by tone. Borrow one outright or use it as a starting point with your town or gym in front.

cta.text: Put the name on a jersey

list: Make sure the scorekeeper can say it.
A pun is funny for one season. A classic name lasts.
Short names fit better across a jersey chest.
Check the league list for duplicates.
Skip NBA and college names. They are trademarks.

faq.q: What are good basketball team names?
faq.a: Classic ones use the language of the game: Fast Break Club, Rim Rockers, Baseline Bandits. Funny ones play on mistakes: Air Ballers, Double Dribblers.

faq.q: What is a good name for a youth basketball team?
faq.a: Something short and friendly, such as Hoop Troop, Net Ninjas or Court Comets.

faq.q: Can we name our team after an NBA team?
faq.a: Kids' leagues often do informally, but NBA names and logos are trademarks and cannot be printed on custom jerseys.

faq.q: How long should a team name be?
faq.a: Two or three words. It has to fit in an arc above the number.

faq.q: How do we get the name on jerseys?
faq.a: Wooter's design service is free. Send the name and your colors, and a designer returns a mockup in 1 to 2 business days.
